nodes.name: Hydrothermal Synthesis and Carbothermal Shock
nodes.procedure: (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O (740 mg) was separately dispersed in 80 mL of deionized (DI) water. The mixture was transferred into an autoclave, and a piece of NF (4.5 cm × 4.5 cm) was vertically immersed into the solution and kept at 150 °C for 6 h. Then, Mo-based oxides were collected and dried. Then, a rapid carbothermal shocking method and hydrogen reduction were applied... heated at 800 °C on a graphite heating plate for 133 seconds under Ar-H2 flow.

nodes.name: Electrochemical Anodic Reconstruction
nodes.procedure: MoO2/NF was placed in 1.0 M KOH solution with 0.28 mM Fe(NO3)3·9H2O as the working electrode. Subsequently, electrochemical anodic reconstruction was performed at a constant voltage (0.87 V vs. Hg/HgO) for 2 h to obtain the amorphous FeMoOOH/NF electrocatalysts.
